A spacious and beautifully renovated corner residence in Governor’s Tower, offering approximately 1,211 sq. ft. of well-designed living space in the heart of Yaletown.

Enjoy a southeast exposure with open views toward False Creek and David Lam Park, along with generous living spaces, a custom dressing room and a large solarium that works perfectly as a home office or additional sitting area.

Rent: $4,599/month
Address: Unit 805 – 388 Drake Street, Vancouver, BC V6B 6A8
Building: Governor’s Tower by Concord Pacific
Size: Approximately 1,211 sq. ft.
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2
Additional Spaces: Custom Dressing Room + Solarium
Exposure: Southeast Corner Unit
Parking: 1 underground parking stall

Residence Highlights

* Spacious 1,211 sq. ft. corner floor plan
* Southeast exposure with excellent natural light
* Open views of False Creek and David Lam Park
* Extensively renovated in 2018 with over $150,000 in upgrades
* Custom dressing room featuring built-in cabinetry, hanging space, drawers, shelving, mirrors and integrated lighting
* Large approximately 14’6” × 7’7” solarium suitable for a home office, reading area or additional sitting space
* Renovated kitchen with custom cabinetry

Interior

The spacious living and dining areas are surrounded by large windows, providing plenty of natural light and an open outlook toward the park and waterfront.

The renovated kitchen features custom cabinetry and Miele appliances, with a practical layout connecting naturally to the dining and living areas.

The primary bedroom measures approximately 13’0” × 11’2” and includes an ensuite bathroom and closet.

The second bedroom measures approximately 9’2” × 12’9”, offering a comfortable and functional layout with its own closet.

One of the most distinctive features of the home is the custom dressing room, professionally designed with built-in storage, drawers, hanging areas, display shelving, mirrors and integrated lighting.

The large 14’6” × 7’7” solarium provides additional flexible space and can work well as a home office, reading room or sitting area.

Building Amenities

* 🏊 Indoor swimming pool
* ♨️ Hot tub
* 🧖 Sauna / steam room
* 🏋️ Fitness centre
* 👨‍💼 24-hour concierge
* 🌳 Common garden
* Secure building access
* Underground parking

Yaletown Location

Located in one of Yaletown’s most convenient waterfront neighbourhoods, just steps from David Lam Park and the False Creek Seawall.

Yaletown–Roundhouse Canada Line Station, restaurants, cafés, grocery stores, shopping and everyday conveniences are all within easy walking distance.

The location offers an excellent balance of waterfront recreation, park-side living and downtown convenience.

Rental Requirements

* No smoking
* Pets subject to landlord approval and strata bylaws
* Minimum 12-month lease
* Proof of income and/or funds required
* Credit information may be required
* Tenant insurance required

Viewing Inquiries

When requesting a viewing, please include:

* Number of occupants
* Preferred move-in date
* Expected lease term
* Whether you have pets
* Occupation
* Preferred viewing times
